candidate_proofs.direct_visual_review_note: Root surfaces preserve exact four-root navigation and stable hierarchy across all seven explicit accessibility variants.
Capture and Search remain dismissible, keyboard-safe overlays with no root chrome in all seven explicit variants.
Trust and object inspection preserve context, back path, reading order, and proportional disclosure in all explicit variants.
Setup, permission, offline, degraded, and recovery states name consequences without color-only or motion-only meaning.
Detail, edit, Trash, restore, archive, history, and receipt controls preserve 44-point targets and reversible boundaries.
Interruption, resume, commit, failure, recovery, rollback, and proof preserve focus and semantic continuity.
Exact four-root shell with a dense Today Reality Window; Search and Capture remain toolbar actions and Trust remains contextual.
Today recovery preserves agency, closure language, receipt history, and Undo without shame or urgency.
Goals remain object-led through Direction Field, Life Areas, Full Goal Path, recovery, closure, completed-total continuity, and history.
Time uses native hour-grid geometry for Protected Time, Fixed Commitment, Open Window, and inspectable Reflow Trace.
You grounds local data, optional identity, continuity, notifications, Source Atlas, diagnostics, export, and settings in user control.
Capture is a global local-first composer with proposal, placement, privacy, and explicit Save boundary; it has no root dock.
Search is a typed privacy-aware global overlay with object-led results, action preview, and no root dock.
Trust is object-bound inspection of why, source, privacy, history, receipt, and Undo; it is never persistent root chrome.
First use establishes local value before optional identity or permissions and preserves denial, interruption, and resume paths.
Offline is normal; degraded states name exact consequence and preserve deterministic continue, inspect, retry, export, and repair paths.
Canonical object detail keeps edit, delete, Trash, restore, archive, recurrence, history, receipts, privacy, and ownership in one boundary.
Principal journeys expose checkpoint, interruption, resume, commit boundary, failure, recovery, receipt, and rollback without guessing.

claim_ceiling: Visual design authority candidate only for the exact Figma/canon mapping scope; no source UI, runtime, rendered-app Visual, accessibility, device, privacy/legal, TestFlight, App Store, or release Green claim.
